turns.question: What was the median time in hours between an outreach message and the partner's reply, for messages sent between 1 and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median time in hours between an outreach message and the partner's reply, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Reply rate (the share of outreach messages that got a reply, counted on the day the message was sent) and Messages sent and Messages replied (counted on the day sent), which show how many messages were sent and answered but not reply times.
